verdict.rationale: Docs are a fair axis for a game engine, so the story applies, but runtime probes show docs.godotengine.org and godotengine.org both return 404 for llms.txt and have no .md mirrors of docs pages. The Asset Library JSON API and the built-in GDScript language server are adjacent tooling, not agent-oriented documentation, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
